name: tag-ids-valid-quoted-and-length-limits
description: Only an id attribute matching [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64} is kept. "refund policy" has a space and a 65-character id is too long: both fall back to sys<n>, n being the position among the request_system items (sys1, sys3). The single-quoted id terms.v2 and a 64-character id are valid and kept.

messages.content:
<document id="refund policy">Refunds within 30 days.</document>
<document id='terms.v2' title="Terms">Terms apply to all plans.</document>
<document id="xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx">Ids longer than 64 characters are not kept.</document>
<doc id="kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk">An id of exactly 64 characters is kept.</doc>
Answer politely.
Do the terms apply to my plan?
